_comment: Estimated USD per 1M tokens. Claude rows: Anthropic first-party list prices (cache_read = 0.1x input, 0.025x on fable-5-1; cache_creation = 1.25x input, the 5-minute TTL write premium). Lookup: exact model id, then the id with its date suffix stripped, then longest key prefix. A model not found is reported as 未定价 (unpriced), never guessed. codex.default is null until the team fills it from its own OpenAI plan - null means Codex tokens are shown but not priced.

codex._comment: Codex sessions only expose input / cached_input / output / reasoning totals per session, no model. Fill default from your plan: {"input": .., "cached_input": .., "output": ..} per 1M tokens (reasoning tokens are billed as output).
